Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 shows subtle peripheral opacities in the right lung (indicated by arrows), while Figure 2 demonstrates significantly increased, dense consolidation involving the majority of the right hemithorax. This progression from focal to extensive opacity over 18 days is consistent with the worsening or progression of COVID-19 pneumonia rather than resolution, pneumothorax, or isolated bacterial superinfection without context.
